artifacts.synopsis: Following the SJC's 2014-01 remand directing Ohio Valley Presbytery to 'hear further' from TE Hickey regarding his stated difference on Larger Catechism 177 (paedocommunion), the SJC denied Aven's complaint that OVP failed adequately to comply, finding that OVP did sufficiently hear further from the minister. A significant dissent argued OVP did not satisfy the specific directives from Case 2014-01.

artifacts.synopsis: Heartland Presbytery sustained the transfer of TE Geoff Smith from an OPC presbytery with stated differences on WCF 19 (the law), without adequately considering or disclosing to the full presbytery that the OPC had declared Smith's views outside the system of doctrine and had restricted him from teaching them. The SJC sustained the complaint and remanded to Heartland for further action, with a dissent arguing there was no clear error under BCO 39-3(3).
